They were led by first-year head coach [[Doug Gottlieb]], and played their home games at [[Resch Center]] in [[Ashwaubenon, Wisconsin]] and [[Kress Events Center]] in [[Green Bay, Wisconsin]] as members of the [[Horizon League]]. ==Previous season== The [[2023–24 Green Bay Phoenix men's basketball team|Phoenix]] finished the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2023–24 season]] 18–14, 13–7 in [[2023–24 Horizon League men's basketball season|Horizon League play]], to finish in a tie for third place.
